# Aven Automation

Aven Automation is an Industrial Entrance Automation company based in Pune, Maharashtra, India.

We provide:

- Automatic Sliding Gates
- Automatic Swing Gates
- Telescopic Sliding Gates
- High Speed Doors
- Roll Up Doors
- Clean Room Doors
- Industrial Sectional Doors
- Garage Doors
- Boom Barriers
- Swing Barriers
- Rising Bollards
- Hangar Doors
- Gate Automation Motors
- Rolling Shutter Motors
